name: serverless-event-driven-architecture

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: The current implementation lacks proper authentication mechanisms, allowing potential attackers to access API endpoints and event channels without verification. Inter-service communication also lacks proper authentication controls.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker could directly access API Gateway endpoints or publish malicious events to EventBridge/SNS topics without authentication, potentially triggering unauthorized Lambda executions or accessing sensitive data.

recommendations.description: Implement Amazon Cognito for user authentication and authorization
recommendations.implementationDetails: Set up Cognito User Pools for end-user authentication and Identity Pools for AWS service access. Enable MFA for additional security.

recommendations.description: Implement fine-grained IAM policies for inter-service communication
recommendations.implementationDetails: Use resource-based policies and IAM roles with least privilege principle for all service interactions. Update Lambda execution roles, S3 bucket policies, and other service permissions.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS WAF with API Gateway for additional request filtering. Consider implementing AWS Organizations for multi-account security. Enable AWS CloudTrail for comprehensive API activity logging.

ground_truth.threatName: Network Exposure and Lack of Network Segmentation

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Services are deployed without proper network isolation, potentially allowing direct internet access to internal components and lacking proper network-level security controls.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker could exploit the lack of network segmentation to access internal services directly or perform lateral movement between services once initial access is gained.

recommendations.description: Implement VPC with proper network segmentation
recommendations.implementationDetails: Create VPC with private and public subnets. Place Lambda functions and databases in private subnets. Use VPC endpoints for AWS service access. Implement proper NACL and Security Group rules.

recommendations.description: Configure VPC endpoints for AWS services
recommendations.implementationDetails: Set up VPC endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, and other AWS services to ensure private communication within the VPC.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS PrivateLink for secure service communication. Implement AWS Network Firewall for additional network protection. Consider AWS Transit Gateway for complex networking scenarios.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Events processed by the system lack proper replay protection mechanisms such as timestamps or unique identifiers, allowing captured events to be replayed.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker captures a legitimate event (e.g., financial transaction) and replays it multiple times, causing the action to be repeated unintentionally.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Add timestamps and unique identifiers to all events. Implement validation logic in Lambda functions to detect and reject replayed events.
Use DynamoDB to track processed event IDs and implement idempotency checks in Lambda functions. Configure proper TTL for event tracking.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS X-Ray for tracing event flows and detecting anomalies. Consider implementing AWS KMS for event signing and verification.

ground_truth.threatName: Denial of Service through Event Flooding

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers could generate a high volume of events through available entry points, overwhelming event processors and causing system degradation.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker floods the API Gateway with requests or publishes a massive number of events to EventBridge, causing Lambda throttling and increased latency.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Configure API Gateway usage plans with rate limiting. Implement SQS throttling and DLQ handling. Set appropriate Lambda concurrency limits.
Add event validation in API Gateway using request validation and AWS WAF. Implement event filtering in EventBridge rules.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS Shield for DDoS protection. Configure CloudWatch alarms for monitoring event processing metrics and detecting anomalies.

mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Sensitive data could be exposed through unencrypted storage, insecure transmission, or improper access controls across various system components.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker gains access to unencrypted data in S3 or intercepts unencrypted data in transit between services.

recommendations.description: Implement encryption for data at rest
recommendations.implementationDetails: Enable encryption for S3 buckets, DynamoDB tables, and other storage services using AWS KMS. Implement proper key rotation and access policies.
Enable TLS for all API communications. Use VPC endpoints with encryption. Enable encryption for SNS/SQS message delivery.
Implement data classification in Lambda functions. Use AWS Macie for sensitive data discovery. Configure proper logging filters to prevent sensitive data exposure.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS Certificate Manager for TLS certificate management. Consider AWS Secrets Manager for sensitive configuration values. Implement AWS Config rules for encryption compliance monitoring.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AWS Serverless Event-driven Architecture Diagram
This script generates a comprehensive architecture diagram showing various event sources,
processing layers, and their interactions in a serverless AWS environment.
"""

# --- AWS Service Category Imports ---
# Integration & Messaging Services
from diagrams.aws.integration import (
    Eventbridge,
    SNS,
    SQS,
    StepFunctions,
)

# Compute Services
from diagrams.aws.compute import (
    Lambda,
)

# Database Services
from diagrams.aws.database import (
    Dynamodb,
)

# Storage Services
from diagrams.aws.storage import (
    S3,
)

# Analytics & Monitoring Services
from diagrams.aws.analytics import (
    KinesisDataFirehose,
    KinesisDataStreams,
)

# Network Services
from diagrams.aws.network import (
    APIGateway,
)

# Management Services
from diagrams.aws.management import (
    Cloudwatch,
)

# Core imports
from diagrams import (
    Diagram,
    Cluster,
    Edge,
)

# Graph styling attributes
graph_attr = {
    "splines": "spline",  # Curved edges for better spacing
    "nodesep": "1.5",    # Increased node separation
    "ranksep": "2.0",    # Increased rank separation
    "pad": "3.0",        # Increased padding
    "concentrate": "true"  # Merge edges to reduce clutter
}

# Define custom edge colors and styles
event_edge = Edge(color="blue", style="bold")
process_edge = Edge(color="green")
error_edge = Edge(color="red", style="dashed")
data_edge = Edge(color="orange")

# Create the diagram
with Diagram(
    "AWS Serverless Event-driven Architecture",
    filename="data/serverless-event-driven-architecture/architecture",
    direction="TB",  # Top to Bottom direction
    graph_attr=graph_attr,
    outformat="png",
    show=False,
) as diag:

    # Client/Device Layer
    with Cluster("Client Layer"):
        from diagrams.programming.framework import Angular
        from diagrams.programming.language import Python
        from diagrams.generic.device import Mobile
        
        web_client = Angular("Web Application")
        mobile_client = Mobile("Mobile App")
        custom_app = Python("Custom Application")

    # Event Sources Cluster
    with Cluster("Event Sources & Integration Layer"):
        with Cluster("API & Gateway"):
            api_gateway = APIGateway("API Gateway\nHTTP/WebSocket")
        
        with Cluster("Event & Message Brokers"):
            eventbridge = Eventbridge("EventBridge\nEvent Router")
            sns = SNS("SNS\nPub/Sub")
            sqs = SQS("SQS\nQueue")
        
        with Cluster("Data Change Events"):
            dynamo_streams = Dynamodb("DynamoDB\nStreams")
            s3_events = S3("S3 Events")
        
        with Cluster("Monitoring & Streaming"):
            cloudwatch = Cloudwatch("CloudWatch")
            kinesis_streams = KinesisDataStreams("Kinesis\nStreams")
            kinesis_firehose = KinesisDataFirehose("Kinesis\nFirehose")

    # Processing Layer Cluster
    with Cluster("Event Processing Layer"):
        with Cluster("Serverless Functions"):
            lambda_primary = Lambda("Primary\nProcessor")
            lambda_secondary = Lambda("Secondary\nProcessor")
        
        with Cluster("Workflow Orchestration"):
            step_functions = StepFunctions("Step Functions")

    # Storage Layer Cluster
    with Cluster("Persistence Layer"):
        s3_storage = S3("S3\nLong-term Storage")
        dynamodb = Dynamodb("DynamoDB\nData Store")

    # Client Connections
    web_client >> Edge(color="purple") >> api_gateway
    mobile_client >> Edge(color="purple") >> api_gateway
    custom_app >> Edge(color="purple") >> eventbridge

    # Event Source Connections with Labels
    eventbridge >> Edge(color="blue", label="Events") >> lambda_primary
    sns >> Edge(color="blue", label="Messages") >> lambda_primary
    sqs >> Edge(color="blue", label="Queued Events") >> lambda_primary
    dynamo_streams >> Edge(color="blue", label="Data Changes") >> lambda_primary
    s3_events >> Edge(color="blue", label="Object Events") >> lambda_primary

    # API Gateway Connections
    api_gateway >> Edge(color="green", label="HTTP/WS") >> lambda_primary
    api_gateway >> Edge(color="green", label="Complex\nWorkflows") >> step_functions

    # Step Functions Orchestration
    step_functions >> Edge(color="green", label="Orchestrated\nTasks") >> lambda_primary
    step_functions >> Edge(color="green", label="Background\nProcessing") >> lambda_secondary

    # Error Handling and DLQ with Labels
    lambda_primary >> Edge(color="red", style="dashed", label="Errors") >> sns
    lambda_secondary >> Edge(color="red", style="dashed", label="DLQ") >> sqs

    # Logging and Monitoring Flow
    cloudwatch >> Edge(color="orange", label="Logs") >> kinesis_firehose
    kinesis_firehose >> Edge(color="orange", label="Archive") >> s3_storage
    cloudwatch >> Edge(color="orange", label="Real-time") >> kinesis_streams
    kinesis_streams >> Edge(color="orange", label="Process") >> lambda_secondary

    # Storage Connections with Labels
    lambda_primary >> Edge(color="orange", label="Store") >> dynamodb
    lambda_primary >> Edge(color="orange", label="Archive") >> s3_storage
    lambda_secondary >> Edge(color="orange", label="Backup") >> s3_storage
